text: 零一万物宣布，杭州市、临平区两级国资联动投资，合计向公司投资数亿元。同时，零一万物总部将落地杭州市临平区，并以此为依托，打造产业AI转型基地。目前，零一万物正在筹备2027年上市，目标做“中国首家实现盈利的AI2.0公司”。（上证报）
text_en: 01.AI announced that state-owned capital from Hangzhou city and Linping district jointly invested several hundred million yuan in the company. At the same time, 01.AI's headquarters will be located in Linping District, Hangzhou, and it will use this as a base to build an industrial AI transformation base. Currently, 01.AI is preparing for an IPO in 2027, with the goal of becoming "China's first profitable AI 2.0 company." (Shanghai Securities News)
